title: Antre Bimbingan
subject: falling for the girl who waits in the same thesis-supervision queue outside a lecturer's office every Tuesday
caption: Indonesian guitar pop in the 2000s Jogja band style. Chiming clean electric guitars on the edge of breakup playing arpeggiated open chords; an acoustic guitar doubling the strum; a melodic electric bass moving between chord tones; drums playing a straight-eighth rock beat with open hi-hat and a tambourine on two and four; a few piano chords under the last chorus. Clean, bright and band-in-a-room, the guitars forward and wide, the voice in the middle, no heavy distortion. Warm, slightly nasal light-baritone male voice, plain and conversational, with an 'oh-oh' singalong hook the band sings along to. 128 BPM, G major. Bright, shy and hopeful. No synths, no power-ballad build, no Malay melisma, no autotune, no electronic drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - jangling guitar arpeggio, then the band]

[Verse 1]
Selasa pagi di lantai tiga
Kursi plastik depan ruangan Bu Ratna
Kamu bab dua, aku bab empat
Kertas kita sama-sama penuh coretan merah

[Pre-Chorus]
Kamu pinjam stabilo, aku pinjam stapler
Kita sama-sama pura-pura nggak gugup

[Chorus - the band sings the oh-oh]
Oh-oh, antre bimbingan
Kamu nomor tujuh, aku delapan
Bu Ratna, tolong datang telat lagi
Aku belum berani minta nomormu

[Verse 2]
Minggu ketiga aku bawa dua gorengan
Satu buat aku, satu "kebetulan lebih"
Kamu bilang revisimu disuruh ulang
Aku bilang punyaku juga, padahal nggak

[Chorus - the band sings the oh-oh]
Oh-oh, antre bimbingan
Kamu nomor tujuh, aku delapan
Bu Ratna, lama banget di dalam
Gorengan kita udah dingin

[Bridge - guitars drop to one arpeggio, tambourine keeps time]
Kalau nanti kita sama-sama lulus
Selasa pagi aku ke mana?
Aku tulis nomorku pelan-pelan
Di pojok kertas revisimu

[Chorus - full band, everyone on the oh-oh]
Oh-oh, antre bimbingan
Kamu nomor tujuh, aku delapan
Kamu masuk duluan, kamu senyum
Kertasnya kamu bawa, nomorku juga

[Outro - guitar arpeggio rings out, one last tambourine hit]
